review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached Wikipedia leads this record now cites, and joined to the atlas through the election of 1921, whose own record names the party and gives its seat count.

summary: The Republican Liberal Party was formed in 1919 out of the two largest conservative republican parties of the day, the Evolutionists and the Unionists, together with figures from Sidónio Pais's party, in order to face the predominance the Democrats had held since 1912. It came first at the legislative election of 10 July 1921 with 79 of the 163 seats in the Chamber — the ballot this atlas holds as the one behind the Noite Sangrenta — and in 1923 it merged with the Reconstitution Party into the Nationalist Republican Party.
